h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Phagwara

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Phagwara

c: Phagwara sits on the GT Road between Jalandhar and Ludhiana, in Punjab's Doaba belt, and the large private university campus on its edge brings thousands of students into the area. FunPlay Systems is an outdoor gym equipment supplier in Phagwara for university and college campuses, schools, factory compounds, gurudwara grounds and residential colonies. We build every machine at our Vasai factory, about 1350 km away.

Orders travel to Punjab by road, and our own team or a north India dealer fixes the machines on site. Phagwara has hot summers, a monsoon from July to September and cold, foggy winters. Students want machines that feel like a real workout. Families in the colonies often prefer gentler stations near their homes. A good open gym in Phagwara usually mixes both, laid out as two clusters.

items.q: How much space does a Cross Fit frame need?
items.a: More than a single machine, because users swing and drop from the bars. Send us your ground's length and width, and our layout drawing will show the frame with its clear space marked.

items.q: Can a gurudwara in Phagwara add a few machines to its grounds?
items.a: Yes. Two or three machines along the boundary wall often fit without touching the main open area. Share photos and the size of the space for a layout.

items.q: Can you supply rubber flooring with the gym?
items.a: Yes. We supply rubber flooring for play areas, and it can also go around outdoor gym machines. Tell us when you ask for a quote, and we will add it to the layout.
